title: 06. Ensemble Methods: Ensemble Learning — runnable code
summary: Ensemble Learning — runnable code: Compare single decision tree vs bagging; Learning curve (number of estimators).

sections.title: Example 1: Bagging (Bootstrap Aggregation)
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 1: Bagging (Bootstrap Aggregation)")
print("-" * 50)

# Generate classification data
X_clf, y_clf = make_classification(
    n_samples=1000,
    n_features=10,
    n_informative=8,
    n_redundant=2,
    n_classes=2,
    random_state=42,
)
X_train_clf, X_test_clf, y_train_clf, y_test_clf = train_test_split(
    X_clf, y_clf, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_clf
)

# Compare single decision tree vs bagging
single_tree = DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=42)
bagging = BaggingClassifier(
    DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=42),
    n_estimators=100,
    max_samples=0.8,
    random_state=42,
)

# Train models
single_tree.fit(X_train_clf, y_train_clf)
bagging.fit(X_train_clf, y_train_clf)

# Evaluate
single_tree_score = single_tree.score(X_test_clf, y_test_clf)
bagging_score = bagging.score(X_test_clf, y_test_clf)

print(f"Single Decision Tree Accuracy: {single_tree_score:.4f}")
print(f"Bagging Ensemble Accuracy: {bagging_score:.4f}")
print(f"Improvement: {bagging_score - single_tree_score:.4f}")

# Cross-validation comparison
single_tree_cv = cross_val_score(single_tree, X_clf, y_clf, cv=5, scoring="accuracy")
bagging_cv = cross_val_score(bagging, X_clf, y_clf, cv=5, scoring="accuracy")

print(f"\nCross-Validation Results:")
print(f"Single Tree: {single_tree_cv.mean():.4f} (+/- {single_tree_cv.std() * 2:.4f})")
print(f"Bagging: {bagging_cv.mean():.4f} (+/- {bagging_cv.std() * 2:.4f})")

# Visualize comparison
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 5))

# Accuracy comparison
plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)
models = ["Single Tree", "Bagging"]
scores = [single_tree_score, bagging_score]
bars = plt.bar(models, scores, color=["skyblue", "lightcoral"])
plt.ylabel("Accuracy Score")
plt.title("Single Tree vs Bagging")
plt.ylim(0, 1)
for bar, score in zip(bars, scores):
    plt.text(
        bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
        bar.get_height() + 0.01,
        f"{score:.4f}",
        ha="center",
        va="bottom",
    )
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# CV scores comparison
plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)
plt.boxplot([single_tree_cv, bagging_cv], labels=["Single Tree", "Bagging"])
plt.ylabel("Accuracy Score")
plt.title("Cross-Validation Comparison")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Learning curve (number of estimators)
plt.subplot(1, 3, 3)
n_estimators_range = [1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100]
bagging_scores = []

for n_est in n_estimators_range:
    bagging_temp = BaggingClassifier(
        DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=42),
        n_estimators=n_est,
        max_samples=0.8,
        random_state=42,
    )
    cv_score = cross_val_score(
        bagging_temp, X_clf, y_clf, cv=5, scoring="accuracy"
    ).mean()
    bagging_scores.append(cv_score)

plt.plot(n_estimators_range, bagging_scores, "bo-")
plt.xlabel("Number of Estimators")
plt.ylabel("CV Accuracy Score")
plt.title("Bagging Learning Curve")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

sections.title: Example 2: Random Forest (Advanced Bagging)
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 2: Random Forest (Advanced Bagging)")
print("-" * 50)

# Generate regression data
X_reg, y_reg = make_regression(n_samples=1000, n_features=10, noise=20, random_state=42)
X_train_reg, X_test_reg, y_train_reg, y_test_reg = train_test_split(
    X_reg, y_reg, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Compare different ensemble sizes
n_estimators_range = [1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 200]
rf_scores = []
rf_times = []

for n_est in n_estimators_range:
    rf = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=n_est, random_state=42)
    cv_score = cross_val_score(rf, X_reg, y_reg, cv=5, scoring="r2").mean()
    rf_scores.append(cv_score)

# Train final model
rf_final = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
rf_final.fit(X_train_reg, y_train_reg)

# Feature importance
feature_importance = rf_final.feature_importances_
feature_names = [f"Feature {i+1}" for i in range(X_reg.shape[1])]

print(f"Random Forest R² Score: {rf_final.score(X_test_reg, y_test_reg):.4f}")

# Visualize Random Forest results
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 5))

# Learning curve
plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)
plt.plot(n_estimators_range, rf_scores, "bo-")
plt.xlabel("Number of Trees")
plt.ylabel("CV R² Score")
plt.title("Random Forest Learning Curve")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Feature importance
plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)
sorted_idx = np.argsort(feature_importance)
plt.barh(range(len(sorted_idx)), feature_importance[sorted_idx])
plt.yticks(range(len(sorted_idx)), [feature_names[i] for i in sorted_idx])
plt.xlabel("Feature Importance")
plt.title("Random Forest Feature Importance")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Predictions vs Actual
plt.subplot(1, 3, 3)
y_pred_rf = rf_final.predict(X_test_reg)
plt.scatter(y_test_reg, y_pred_rf, alpha=0.6)
plt.plot(
    [y_test_reg.min(), y_test_reg.max()],
    [y_test_reg.min(), y_test_reg.max()],
    "r--",
    lw=2,
)
plt.xlabel("Actual Values")
plt.ylabel("Predicted Values")
plt.title("Random Forest: Predictions vs Actual")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

sections.title: Example 3: AdaBoost
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 3: AdaBoost")
print("-" * 50)

# Create imbalanced dataset for AdaBoost
X_imb, y_imb = make_classification(
    n_samples=1000,
    n_features=10,
    n_informative=8,
    n_redundant=2,
    n_classes=2,
    weights=[0.8, 0.2],
    random_state=42,
)
X_train_imb, X_test_imb, y_train_imb, y_test_imb = train_test_split(
    X_imb, y_imb, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_imb
)

# Compare AdaBoost with different base estimators
base_estimators = {
    "Decision Stump": DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=1, random_state=42),
    "Decision Tree": DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3, random_state=42),
    "SVM": SVC(probability=True, random_state=42),
}

adaboost_results = {}

for name, base_est in base_estimators.items():
    adaboost = AdaBoostClassifier(
        base_estimator=base_est, n_estimators=100, learning_rate=1.0, random_state=42
    )

    # Train and evaluate
    adaboost.fit(X_train_imb, y_train_imb)
    y_pred = adaboost.predict(X_test_imb)

    # Calculate metrics
    accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test_imb, y_pred)
    precision = precision_score(y_test_imb, y_pred)
    recall = recall_score(y_test_imb, y_pred)
    f1 = f1_score(y_test_imb, y_pred)

    adaboost_results[name] = {
        "accuracy": accuracy,
        "precision": precision,
        "recall": recall,
        "f1": f1,
    }

    print(f"{name}:")
    print(f"  Accuracy: {accuracy:.4f}")
    print(f"  Precision: {precision:.4f}")
    print(f"  Recall: {recall:.4f}")
    print(f"  F1-Score: {f1:.4f}")

# Visualize AdaBoost results
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 5))

# Metrics comparison
plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)
metrics = ["accuracy", "precision", "recall", "f1"]
x = np.arange(len(metrics))
width = 0.25

for i, (name, results) in enumerate(adaboost_results.items()):
    values = [results[metric] for metric in metrics]
    plt.bar(x + i * width, values, width, label=name, alpha=0.8)

plt.xlabel("Metrics")
plt.ylabel("Score")
plt.title("AdaBoost Performance Comparison")
plt.xticks(x + width, metrics)
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Learning curve for best AdaBoost
best_adaboost = AdaBoostClassifier(
    base_estimator=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=1, random_state=42),
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=1.0,
    random_state=42,
)

n_estimators_range = [1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100]
adaboost_scores = []

for n_est in n_estimators_range:
    adaboost_temp = AdaBoostClassifier(
        base_estimator=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=1, random_state=42),
        n_estimators=n_est,
        learning_rate=1.0,
        random_state=42,
    )
    cv_score = cross_val_score(
        adaboost_temp, X_imb, y_imb, cv=5, scoring="accuracy"
    ).mean()
    adaboost_scores.append(cv_score)

plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)
plt.plot(n_estimators_range, adaboost_scores, "bo-")
plt.xlabel("Number of Estimators")
plt.ylabel("CV Accuracy Score")
plt.title("AdaBoost Learning Curve")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Feature importance for AdaBoost
best_adaboost.fit(X_train_imb, y_train_imb)
feature_importance_ada = best_adaboost.feature_importances_

plt.subplot(1, 3, 3)
sorted_idx = np.argsort(feature_importance_ada)
plt.barh(range(len(sorted_idx)), feature_importance_ada[sorted_idx])
plt.yticks(range(len(sorted_idx)), [f"Feature {i+1}" for i in sorted_idx])
plt.xlabel("Feature Importance")
plt.title("AdaBoost Feature Importance")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```python
print("\nExample 4: Gradient Boosting")
```

```python
print("\nExample 5: XGBoost")
print("-" * 50)

try:
    import xgboost as xgb

    # XGBoost for classification
    xgb_clf = xgb.XGBClassifier(
        n_estimators=100, learning_rate=0.1, max_depth=3, random_state=42
    )

    xgb_clf.fit(X_train_clf, y_train_clf)
    xgb_score = xgb_clf.score(X_test_clf, y_test_clf)

    print(f"XGBoost Accuracy: {xgb_score:.4f}")

    # Compare with other boosting methods
    boosting_comparison = {
        "AdaBoost": AdaBoostClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42),
        "Gradient Boosting": GradientBoostingClassifier(
            n_estimators=100, random_state=42
        ),
        "XGBoost": xgb_clf,
    }

    boosting_results = {}

    for name, model in boosting_comparison.items():
        if name != "XGBoost":  # Already trained
            model.fit(X_train_clf, y_train_clf)

        y_pred = model.predict(X_test_clf)
        accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test_clf, y_pred)
        f1 = f1_score(y_test_clf, y_pred)

        boosting_results[name] = {"accuracy": accuracy, "f1": f1}
        print(f"{name}: Accuracy = {accuracy:.4f}, F1 = {f1:.4f}")

    # Visualize XGBoost results
    plt.figure(figsize=(15, 5))

    # Performance comparison
    plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)
    models = list(boosting_results.keys())
    accuracies = [boosting_results[model]["accuracy"] for model in models]
    bars = plt.bar(models, accuracies, color=["skyblue", "lightcoral", "lightgreen"])
    plt.ylabel("Accuracy Score")
    plt.title("Boosting Methods Comparison")
    plt.ylim(0, 1)
    for bar, acc in zip(bars, accuracies):
        plt.text(
            bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
            bar.get_height() + 0.01,
            f"{acc:.4f}",
            ha="center",
            va="bottom",
        )
    plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    # XGBoost feature importance
    plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)
    feature_importance_xgb = xgb_clf.feature_importances_
    sorted_idx = np.argsort(feature_importance_xgb)
    plt.barh(range(len(sorted_idx)), feature_importance_xgb[sorted_idx])
    plt.yticks(range(len(sorted_idx)), [f"Feature {i+1}" for i in sorted_idx])
    plt.xlabel("Feature Importance")
    plt.title("XGBoost Feature Importance")
    plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    # Learning curves comparison
    plt.subplot(1, 3, 3)
    n_estimators_range = [1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100]

    for name, model_class in boosting_comparison.items():
        if name == "XGBoost":
            model_class = xgb.XGBClassifier
        elif name == "AdaBoost":
            model_class = AdaBoostClassifier
        elif name == "Gradient Boosting":
            model_class = GradientBoostingClassifier

        scores = []
        for n_est in n_estimators_range:
            if name == "XGBoost":
                model_temp = model_class(
                    n_estimators=n_est, learning_rate=0.1, max_depth=3, random_state=42
                )
            elif name == "AdaBoost":
                model_temp = model_class(n_estimators=n_est, random_state=42)
            else:
                model_temp = model_class(
                    n_estimators=n_est, learning_rate=0.1, max_depth=3, random_state=42
                )

            cv_score = cross_val_score(
                model_temp, X_clf, y_clf, cv=3, scoring="accuracy"
            ).mean()
            scores.append(cv_score)

        plt.plot(n_estimators_range, scores, "o-", label=name)

    plt.xlabel("Number of Estimators")
    plt.ylabel("CV Accuracy Score")
    plt.title("Boosting Methods Learning Curves")
    plt.legend()
    plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

except ImportError:
    print("XGBoost not installed. Install with: pip install xgboost")
    print("Skipping XGBoost example.")
```

sections.title: Example 6: Voting Classifier
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 6: Voting Classifier")
print("-" * 50)

# Create diverse base models
base_models = [
    ("rf", RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)),
    ("svm", SVC(probability=True, random_state=42)),
    ("knn", KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=5)),
    ("lr", LogisticRegression(random_state=42, max_iter=1000)),
]

# Hard voting (majority vote)
voting_hard = VotingClassifier(estimators=base_models, voting="hard")

# Soft voting (probability weighted)
voting_soft = VotingClassifier(estimators=base_models, voting="soft")

# Train and evaluate
voting_hard.fit(X_train_clf, y_train_clf)
voting_soft.fit(X_train_clf, y_train_clf)

hard_score = voting_hard.score(X_test_clf, y_test_clf)
soft_score = voting_soft.score(X_test_clf, y_test_clf)

print(f"Hard Voting Accuracy: {hard_score:.4f}")
print(f"Soft Voting Accuracy: {soft_score:.4f}")

# Compare individual models
individual_scores = {}
for name, model in base_models:
    model.fit(X_train_clf, y_train_clf)
    score = model.score(X_test_clf, y_test_clf)
    individual_scores[name] = score
    print(f"{name.upper()} Accuracy: {score:.4f}")

# Visualize voting results
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 5))

# Accuracy comparison
plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)
models = list(individual_scores.keys()) + ["Hard Voting", "Soft Voting"]
scores = list(individual_scores.values()) + [hard_score, soft_score]
colors = [
    "skyblue",
    "lightcoral",
    "lightgreen",
    "lightyellow",
    "lightblue",
    "lightpink",
]
bars = plt.bar(models, scores, color=colors)
plt.ylabel("Accuracy Score")
plt.title("Individual Models vs Voting Ensembles")
plt.ylim(0, 1)
for bar, score in zip(bars, scores):
    plt.text(
        bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
        bar.get_height() + 0.01,
        f"{score:.4f}",
        ha="center",
        va="bottom",
    )
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Cross-validation comparison
plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)
cv_scores = {}
for name, model in base_models:
    cv_score = cross_val_score(model, X_clf, y_clf, cv=5, scoring="accuracy")
    cv_scores[name] = cv_score

voting_hard_cv = cross_val_score(voting_hard, X_clf, y_clf, cv=5, scoring="accuracy")
voting_soft_cv = cross_val_score(voting_soft, X_clf, y_clf, cv=5, scoring="accuracy")

cv_data = list(cv_scores.values()) + [voting_hard_cv, voting_soft_cv]
cv_labels = list(cv_scores.keys()) + ["Hard Voting", "Soft Voting"]

plt.boxplot(cv_data, labels=cv_labels)
plt.ylabel("Accuracy Score")
plt.title("Cross-Validation Comparison")
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Best model identification
plt.subplot(1, 3, 3)
best_model = max(scores)
best_model_name = models[scores.index(best_model)]
plt.text(
    0.5,
    0.5,
    f"Best Model:\n{best_model_name}\n\nAccuracy: {best_model:.4f}",
    ha="center",
    va="center",
    fontsize=14,
    bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", facecolor="lightblue"),
)
plt.xlim(0, 1)
plt.ylim(0, 1)
plt.title("Best Performing Model")
plt.axis("off")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

sections.title: Example 7: Stacking (Stacked Generalization)
sections.body:
**What this code covers**

- Exercise 1: Ensemble Method Comparison Compare different ensemble methods (Bagging, Boosting, Voting, Stacking) on the same dataset.
- Project 1: Automated Ensemble Construction System Process: 1.
- Ensemble methods combine multiple models to improve performance 2.
- Create base models for stacking
- Compare with voting and individual models

```python
print("\nExample 7: Stacking (Stacked Generalization)")

# Create base models for stacking
base_models_stacking = [
    ("rf", RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)),
    ("svm", SVC(probability=True, random_state=42)),
    ("knn", KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=5)),
    ("lr", LogisticRegression(random_state=42, max_iter=1000)),
]

# Meta-learner
meta_learner = LogisticRegression(random_state=42, max_iter=1000)

# Create stacking classifier
stacking = StackingClassifier(
    estimators=base_models_stacking,
    final_estimator=meta_learner,
    cv=5,
    stack_method="predict_proba",
)

# Train and evaluate
stacking.fit(X_train_clf, y_train_clf)
stacking_score = stacking.score(X_test_clf, y_test_clf)

print(f"Stacking Accuracy: {stacking_score:.4f}")

# Compare with voting and individual models
comparison_models = {
    "Individual Models": individual_scores,
    "Hard Voting": {"Hard Voting": hard_score},
    "Soft Voting": {"Soft Voting": soft_score},
    "Stacking": {"Stacking": stacking_score},
}

# Visualize stacking results
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 5))

# Performance comparison
plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)
all_models = []
all_scores = []

for category, models_dict in comparison_models.items():
    for model_name, score in models_dict.items():
        all_models.append(model_name)
        all_scores.append(score)

bars = plt.bar(
    all_models,
    all_scores,
    color=["skyblue"] * 4 + ["lightcoral", "lightgreen", "lightblue"],
)
plt.ylabel("Accuracy Score")
plt.title("All Ensemble Methods Comparison")
plt.ylim(0, 1)
for bar, score in zip(bars, all_scores):
    plt.text(
        bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
        bar.get_height() + 0.01,
        f"{score:.4f}",
        ha="center",
        va="bottom",
    )
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Cross-validation for stacking
plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)
stacking_cv = cross_val_score(stacking, X_clf, y_clf, cv=5, scoring="accuracy")
voting_hard_cv = cross_val_score(voting_hard, X_clf, y_clf, cv=5, scoring="accuracy")
```
